_comment: Provenance for the SVG-format curated flags under public/historical-flags/.
Each entry: local filename -> the exact Wikimedia Commons file it was fetched from,
the date fetched, a sha256 of the bytes, and WHY the flag is needed (which era/polity
was showing an out-of-period flag before it was bundled). Re-fetch or verify with
The sourced from/to window for each of these lives in src/data/historicalFlagValidity.ts.

portugal-1750.svg.why: 1815 Portugal and its colonies were showing the 1816 United-Kingdom-of-Portugal-Brazil-Algarves arms, a year before that flag existed.

siam-1782.svg.why: 1815 Rattanakosin was showing the 1817 white-elephant-in-chakra flag; the plain red civil ensign flew until 1855.

siam-1855.svg.why: 1880/1900/1914 Siam was showing the 1817-1855 chakra flag; Mongkut's white elephant flew 1855-1917.

france-royal-banner.svg.why: 1500 France was showing the white Bourbon flag, which dates from 1590; the Valois royal banner was azure semé of fleurs-de-lis.

persia-1886.svg.why: 1900 Persia was showing the 1907 constitutional flag.

russia-1858.svg.why: 1880 Russia was shown the white-blue-red tricolour, which was the civil ensign; the STATE flag 1858-1896 was black-yellow-white.

rsfsr-1918.svg.commons: Flag of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (1918–1925).svg
rsfsr-1918.svg.why: The 1920 map labels the Soviet state 'USSR' (founded 1922) and flew the USSR flag; in 1920 the polity was the Russian SFSR.

brunei-1906.svg.why: 1914-1945 Brunei was showing the pre-1906 plain yellow flag.

yemen-1918.svg.commons: Flag of the Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen (1918-1927).svg
yemen-1918.svg.why: 1920 Yemen was showing the 1927 sword-and-stars flag.

mongolia-1924.svg.why: 1938 Mongolia was showing the 1945 Soyombo flag.

iraq-1959.svg.why: 1960 Iraq was showing the Kingdom's 1924-1959 flag, abolished by the 1958 revolution.

spain-1945.svg.why: 1945 and 1960 Spain were showing the 1785-1931 royal ensign.

malaya-1950.svg.why: 1960 Federation of Malaya had no flag at all — the modern Malaysian flag is gated to 1963.

uar-1958.svg.commons: Flag of the United Arab Republic (1958–1971), Flag of Syria (1980–2024).svg
uar-1958.svg.why: 1960 Egypt and Syria were the United Arab Republic, whose flag is gated out by Egypt's 1984 adoption year.

brazil-1889.svg.why: 1900–1945 Brazil showed no flag at all: the republican flag has flown since 1889 but its star field was redrawn as states joined, so the modern 27-star version is refused.

brazil-1960.svg.why: 1960 Brazil: the 22-star field adopted when Guanabara became a state.

mongolia-1911.svg.why: 1914 Mongolia showed no flag; the Bogd Khanate flew this one from 1911.

sudan-1956.svg.why: 1960 Sudan showed no flag; the modern flag dates from 1970.

mali-1959.svg.why: 1960 Mali showed no flag; the plain tricolour replaced this kanaga version in 1961.

upper-volta-1959.svg.why: 1960 Upper Volta showed no flag; this black-white-red tricolour flew 1959–1984.

panama-1903.svg.why: 1914 and 1920 Panama showed no flag; the 1925 standardisation is what the modern adoption year records.

serbia-1882.svg.why: 1880 and 1914 Serbia showed no flag; the modern flag dates from 2010.

albania-1914.svg.why: 1914 Albania showed no flag; the modern flag dates from 1992.

eritrea-1952.svg.why: 1960 Eritrea, federated with Ethiopia, had its own flag; the modern one dates from 1995.

congo-leopoldville-1960.svg.commons: Flag of the Republic of the Congo (Léopoldville) (1960–1963).svg
congo-leopoldville-1960.svg.why: 1960 Congo-Léopoldville showed no flag though it became independent that June.

iceland-1915.png.why: 1920 Iceland showed no flag; the sovereign kingdom adopted this in 1915 (Commons holds only a PNG).

montenegro-1860.svg.why: 1880 Montenegro showed no flag; this is the principality's flag, 1860–1905.

montenegro-1905.png.why: 1914 Montenegro showed no flag; the kingdom's flag flew 1905–1918 (Commons holds only a PNG).

mauritania-1959.svg.why: 1960 Mauritania showed no flag; the 2017 redesign added the red bands, so the modern adoption year refused the original.

cameroon-1957.svg.why: 1960 Cameroon showed no flag; the modern two-star and then single-star versions came later.

nepal-1743.svg.why: 1880–1960 Nepal showed no flag; the double-pennon is ancient but its 1962 standardisation is what the adoption year records.

bhutan-1956.svg.why: 1960 Bhutan showed no flag; the modern flag dates from 1969.

muscat-oman.svg.why: 1880–1960 Oman showed no flag; the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman flew a plain red flag until 1970.

qatar-1936.svg.why: 1938 and 1945 Qatar showed no flag; the modern maroon-and-white flag dates from 1971.
